text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Special Week took part in a 
cooking contest held in the shopping 
district.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to Chef Bakuozan's Harsh Cooking 
Contest! Our next challenger is Special 
Week from Tracen Academy!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I-I'll be in your care!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Special Week-san! What made you 
decide to participate in this contest 
today?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... I guess you could call it a test 
of skill? I just... wanted to test 
myself...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
A little while ago... I grew to absolutely 
love cooking!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And I've made all kinds of dishes since. 
Rice balls, ramen, omurice... Even 
low-calorie bento boxes!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I've grown a little bit 
compared to before! So, I thought I'd give 
it a shot...!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
I see! So you're confident in your cooking 
skills! Well then, what did you make for 
us?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! It's carrot hamburg steak! It's my 
mom's specialty! Mine isn't quite as good 
as hers, but I gave it my all!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Oho! A contest of nostalgic flavors, is 
it?! —Well then, let the best dish win!

text_block_list.name: Baku Ozan
text_block_list.text:
The air wasn't beaten out enough. You 
baked it too long as well. You should have 
killed the heat a minute earlier. —Failed.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Baku Ozan
text_block_list.text:
You were nervous, weren't you? I could 
taste it in the Salisbury steak.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...What?! You can even tell something like 
that?!

text_block_list.name: Baku Ozan
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't bad. It tasted like it had a 
future. —Come back and challenge it again 
anytime.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, it's so frustrating... I really 
thought I had improved in my own way."
choice_data_list:
Still, didn't they say it tasted full of 
potential?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The future... Is it all right for me to 
believe that you have high hopes for me?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...Cooking is really fun, and if 
anything, I'd love to get even better at 
it..."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, I just can't leave things like 
this! I'm going to enter another cooking 
contest!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"It's no good... The heat control 
definitely improved, but whether it became 
dramatically more delicious is..."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
To begin with, is carrot hamburg steak 
really the right choice? I wish I could 
make it like Mom does, but maybe I should 
compete with a different dish—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Hnnngh. Urrgh! Now I'm completely 
lost--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Grrrrrrrrroooowl~!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oof!? My stomach... Come to think of it, I 
haven't had dinner yet...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Special Week was so focused she lost track 
of time. While she threw herself into her 
cooking, I handed her what I had made.
choice_data_list:
Here. It's just a plain salted rice ball, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Trainer... did you make this? For me?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Wah, I'm so happy! I'll dig in right 
away!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
*nom*! Mmm~! So crazy... mmm!? What in the 
world, this is so delicious~~~!!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer-san! How did you make this 
salted rice ball!?
choice_data_list: Huh? I just gripped it normally, but...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? That's all!? Really? No special 
cooking methods or—
choice_data_list:
I just made it because I wanted to cheer 
you on.

I just made it because I wanted to cheer 
you on.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I see... I get it now. I understand!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Super delicious ramen shops, and 
restaurants featured on TV too!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Rather than focusing only on the cooking 
itself, the bento I made specifically for 
you, Trainer, turned out so much more 
delicious!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"So, that was it—I shouldn't just focus 
solely on making it."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"When you cook with the person who's going 
to eat it in mind, the food turns out so 
much more delicious!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: All riiight! With this—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for joining us again following 
last week! What will you be cooking 
today?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Piping hot rice, grilled fish, 
pickled radish, and miso soup!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I read Chef Ozan's interview the other 
day! He mentioned that what got him 
interested in cooking was his mother's 
home cooking!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So, I tried to recreate the taste of 
Teacher's mother's home cooking in my own 
way!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Osyama-sensei was born in an area known 
for delicious fish, so I figured grilled 
fish should be the main dish!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
I see! A dish tailored with Ouzan-sensei's 
personal tastes in mind! Now then, will 
that turn out for the better or the 
worse?!

text_block_list.name: Baku Ozan
text_block_list.text: ...Very delicious. You pass.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh!? Did it finally happen?! Master 
Ozan has finally given his stamp of 
approval--!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yay!! I did it... I did itttt--!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much! I'm so happy, eheheh!

text_block_list.name: Baku Ozan
text_block_list.text:
A set meal that radiates the determination 
to make the diner say 
'Delicious'—wonderful indeed.

text_block_list.name: Baku Ozan
text_block_list.text:
And it isn't just delicious... I can tell 
that she always cooks with someone special 
in mind.

text_block_list.name: Baku Ozan
text_block_list.text:
You want to make someone smile with your 
cooking— you have someone like that, don't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes!!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"So, I'm... going to keep doing my best 
with my cooking!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Then, after gazing at me for just a 
moment, Special Week continued—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Because I want to see the smile of the 
person most precious to me even more!
